name: howto-tutorial
summary: Narrated how-to: intro, numbered steps on screenshots with camera zoom/pan + callouts, key-points / compare / checklist scenes, outro; emits chapters

slots.title: <= 48 chars
slots.subtitle: optional
slots.sections: list of {kind: intro|step|three|compare|checklist|outro, title, vo, ...}; step: body, image, focus {x,y,zoom}, callout {x,y,text}; three: points[3]; compare: left/right {label, points}; checklist: items[]; outro: cta, url
slots.ai_voice_disclosure: default true: shows 'Narration: AI-generated voice' when TTS narration is used

notes: Narration drives timing (scene >= VO + pads). Lock the script before voicing; cached VO is reused. Chapters go to job.json for youtube_prep.py.
